mapper.sql: t.id, t.name, t.abbreviation, t.description, t.created_at, t.updated_at, d.id AS d_id, d.name AS d_name, d.data_type AS d_data_type, d.data_length AS d_data_length, d.data_scale AS d_data_scale, d.description AS d_description, d.created_at AS d_created_at, d.updated_at AS d_updated_at, cw.id AS d_cw_id, cw.name AS d_cw_name, cw.abbreviation AS d_cw_abbreviation, cw.english_name AS d_cw_english_name, cw.description AS d_cw_description, cw.classifier AS d_cw_classifier, cw.created_at AS d_cw_created_at, cw.updated_at AS d_cw_updated_at
FROM std_term t JOIN std_domain d ON d.id = t.domain_id JOIN std_word cw ON cw.id = d.classifier_word_id
mapper.select: SELECT tw.term_id, tw.seq, w.id AS w_id, w.name AS w_name, w.abbreviation AS w_abbreviation, w.english_name AS w_english_name, w.description AS w_description, w.classifier AS w_classifier, w.created_at AS w_created_at, w.updated_at AS w_updated_at FROM std_term_word tw JOIN std_word w ON w.id = tw.word_id WHERE tw.term_id IN #{id} ORDER BY tw.term_id, tw.seq
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM std_term WHERE domain_id = #{domainId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT term_id) FROM std_term_word WHERE word_id = #{wordId}

where.if: AND (UPPER(t.name) LIKE #{keywordUpper} ESCAPE '!' OR t.abbreviation LIKE #{keywordUpper} ESCAPE '!')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM std_term_word tw WHERE tw.term_id = t.id AND tw.word_id = #{c.wordId})

mapper.select:
SELECT

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO std_term (name, abbreviation, domain_id, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{abbreviation}, #{domain.id}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO std_term_word (term_id, seq, word_id) VALUES (#{termId}, #{seq}, #{wordId})
